description: One session of the VC QoE Overview (uid vc-qoe-overview), opened with its own time range so that zooming here never moves the Overview. Generated by make_dashboard_v2.py.

options.content: **One session.** Opened from the Overview's session table, with this tab's time range set to the session (start to last bin + 5 s). **Zoom freely**: the Overview is another dashboard with its own time range, so nothing there moves. The *Session* box lists the sessions active in this tab's range; picking another one keeps the range. **A gap is not a zero**: a field with no value in a bin is not written (for example no fps while no video stream is counted).

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r.session_id == "${session}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "fps_uplink")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value), _field: "uplink"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

        last_bin_end: r._time,
        duration_min: r._value / 60.0}))

spec.description: Start is derived as (last bin in range) - session_age_s, so it does not move when you zoom; last_bin_end and duration_min describe the part of the session inside the current range.

spec.description: pps_uplink and pps_downlink: packets / 5 s of every counted packet (after de-dup).
spec.title: Packets per second

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "session_metrics" and r.session_id == "${session}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rtp_loss_pct_uplink" or r._field == "rtp_loss_pct_downlink" or r._field == "loss_pct_uplink" or r._field == "seq_gap_pct_downlink")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value), _field: if r._field == "rtp_loss_pct_uplink" then "uplink loss (pooled RTP)" else if r._field == "rtp_loss_pct_downlink" then "downlink loss (pooled RTP)" else if r._field == "loss_pct_uplink" then "uplink loss (video)" else "downlink seq gap (not loss)"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: Two engines, two quantities, on purpose. Teams/Meet: rtp_loss_pct_* = all RTP streams pooled (audio + video). Zoom: loss_pct_uplink = video streams only; seq_gap_pct_downlink is NOT loss (Zoom's server forwards a subset of frames with the sender's numbering). Only the lines that exist for this session's platform are drawn.
spec.title: Packet loss / sequence gap (%)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "session_id")
